card.summary: The Doug LaMalfa Federal Disaster Tax Relief Certainty Act amends the Internal Revenue Code to codify and extend tax relief rules for individuals affected by major disasters and certain wildfires. It allows individuals to deduct qualified personal casualty losses arising from major disasters with incident periods beginning before January 1, 2027, and excludes qualified wildfire relief payments from gross income for forest or range fires declared as federal disasters after 2014 and before 2027.
